exemptions.scope: Windows title-bar menus, native caption controls, theme projection and current-account ordering
exemptions.reason: Native window-frame presentation forwards existing Electron menu handlers through a bounded trusted-frame bridge. Account ordering and Active/Saved labels are presentation only; switching, logout and removal retain the existing local Accounts API deferral.

exemptions.scope: Appearance thumbnail hover and keyboard focus previews
exemptions.reason: Ephemeral decorative rendering only; choosing a background still dispatches settings.device.update. Pausing a covered backdrop does not change the saved background.

exemptions.scope: Notification bell and popover visibility, video link navigation and run ID disclosure
exemptions.reason: Presentation and navigation only; persisted read state uses automation.notifications.read. History is supplied by automation.history.

exemptions.scope: Music page navigation, dock player disclosure/dismissal and focus retention, provider preview tabs, search categories, collection filters, display sorting, editor drafts, read-only catalog requests and queue disclosure
exemptions.reason: Ephemeral presentation and provider reads only. Dock auto-hide and player disclosure do not stop or recreate playback. Sorting preserves Spotify source positions without rewriting playlists. Playlist writes use spotify.playlist.edit with an operation-bound review. Unconnected services have explicit unavailable states. Playback selections and controls use spotify.playback.control; audio activation retains spotify.playback.session.

exemptions.scope: More sidebar disclosure, browser address and homepage form drafts, engine and session menu visibility, downloads disclosure and browser expansion
exemptions.reason: Temporary, reversible presentation, local address suggestions, offline panel dismissal and input drafts only; navigation, engine selection, SearXNG instance and shortcut mutations use browser.session.control and panel visibility uses the Workspace Layout owner.

exemptions.scope: scroll, pointer hover, focus and text selection
exemptions.reason: Input/navigation gesture only; does not commit product state.

exemptions.scope: draft typing and in-view search filters
exemptions.reason: No committed product state; a separate save or submit control commits the change.

exemptions.scope: tooltips, transient pickers and discard prompts
exemptions.reason: Non-persistent presentation only; the underlying committed action is reviewed separately.

exemptions.scope: book shelf rotation and page navigation
exemptions.reason: Presentation/reading gestures only; processing and compiling remain App Actions.

exemptions.scope: Calendar refresh, calendar selection, event search and proposed-slot drafts
exemptions.reason: Read-only provider requests or staged form choices; confirmed event mutations use the Calendar App Actions listed above.

exemptions.scope: Dictation history filters pagination transcript expansion retry clipboard audio export and preference drafts
exemptions.reason: Read-only local history presentation, explicit clipboard/audio exports, and unsaved dictionary or shortcut edits. Saved preferences dispatch dictation.settings.update; deletion dispatches dictation.history.delete with confirmation. Capture and draft insertion retain the conversational transport exemption.

exemptions.scope: GitHub tool catalog browsing/refresh and filters, OAuth continuation links and post-receipt catalog presentation
exemptions.reason: Provider metadata reads, in-view filtering and navigation only. Sign-in lifecycle and verification dispatch typed GitHub connection actions. Review decisions use existing App Action confirmation/cancellation tokens; confirmed provider writes retain github.mcp.execute.

exemptions.scope: Slack app-identity drafts, manifest disclosure/copying, tool metadata browsing/refresh and filtering, OAuth continuation and post-receipt catalog refresh
exemptions.reason: Unsaved public identifier drafts, explicit clipboard copy of a public manifest, provider reads, navigation and in-view presentation only. Saving registration and OAuth lifecycle dispatch typed Slack connection actions. Review decisions use existing confirmation tokens; confirmed provider writes retain slack.mcp.execute.

exemptions.scope: Airtable tool metadata browsing, filters, OAuth continuation and status polling
exemptions.reason: Read-only metadata and transient presentation only. OAuth lifecycle, verification, disconnection and provider changes dispatch the typed Airtable actions; review decisions retain existing confirmation tokens.

exemptions.scope: Notion catalog browsing, in-view filters, OAuth continuation and flow polling
exemptions.reason: Read-only metadata and transient presentation. Connection lifecycle uses typed Notion actions; changes retain exact-input review and canonical confirmation tokens.

exemptions.scope: Firecrawl tool metadata, filters and OAuth status polling
exemptions.reason: Read-only discovery and transient presentation; saved connection lifecycle and provider changes use the typed App Actions and canonical reviews.

exemptions.reason: Read-only discovery and transient presentation; saved connection lifecycle and provider changes use the typed App Actions and canonical reviews.

Verify connection fetches only the enabled connector tool catalog through the existing PluginMcpRuntime. It does not save credentials, grant account access, enable the plugin, or execute a provider operation.

deferred.surface: Google, GitHub and hosted email account identity transport
deferred.reason: Interactive identity authorization, saved-account selection, logout, explicit local continuation and account removal use the dedicated local-UI-only Accounts API. OAuth state, PKCE and device verification are not model tools or generic App Action arguments. The API checks loopback client, Host, exact UI Origin and a non-simple header. Generic App Action parity is deferred; account lifecycle behavior and failure outcomes have focused service, HTTP and mounted UI tests.

deferred.surface: Main Library local notes and project cards
deferred.reason: Legacy local collection mutations still use setLibrary/setProjects; no corresponding App Action definitions.
The specialist On/Off control and settings modal still edit local agentCfg instead of a canonical agent-setting App Action.

deferred.surface: Chat connector selection and custom instructions
deferred.reason: Per-chat app selection, connector-ready badges and custom instructions still update client state without a persisted App Action receipt.

deferred.surface: Dictation capture and experimental dev mode
deferred.reason: Local microphone capture, pause/resume, Done, Cancel and editable transcript insertion are conversational transport, equivalent to composing text. Dictation uses the discovered voice contract, requires browser microphone permission and does not submit an agent turn. The dev-mode shortcut is session-only.
Model, reasoning, access, layout and session controls in the separate coding page are local or coding-API state, not App Action receipts.
The backend action exists but this UI has no create-PR control; only PR open is wired in the coding workspace.

Discord and X Agent Reach/optional OAuth setup still use plugin-specific API contracts. Generic App Action parity is deferred for those operations; Calendar connection/event writes and Spotify connection/player-session writes are covered above.

deferred.surface: Legacy design previews and setup flow
deferred.reason: Not the production entry point; excluded from the served-control lock pending migration or removal.
